text:
ana: Quick sync on token-cost attribution + latency schema — where are we with milestones/owners/deps for this sprint? any CR pings or infra blockers? cc @jordan @maria

jordan: Owner for the pipeline. PR ready but blocked on infra topic creation. https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/1486 :eyes:

maria: I can review today. Quick asks: include sample events for perf tests, confirm `cost_cents` unit, and add latency buckets for SLO dashboards.

praveen: Infra update: kafka topic `metrics-ingest-v2` not provisioned in prod yet — working with cloud infra. ETA EOD tomorrow.

kai: Pushed schema changes to the branch — added `cost_cents`, `token_count`, `model_family`, `latency_ms`, and `latency_bucket`. Example event I put in the PR description: ```json
{
  "event_type": "token_usage",
  "timestamp": "2025-06-14T16:02:00Z",
  "model_family": "redwood-7b",
  "token_count": 142,
  "cost_cents": 12,
  "latency_ms": 243,
  "latency_bucket": "200-300",
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "prompt_type": "completion"
}
```

eng-bot: CI for instrumentation/pull/1486 — build passed :white_check_mark: (unit, lint)

maria: Left a couple inline comments — mainly schema naming and a small test gap around bucket boundaries. Also +1 on `prompt_type` enum, useful for slice-level cost analysis.

ana: (typo) ana: can we also have an alert for token-cost drift? e.g. alert if avg cost per 1k tokens increases >10% vs baseline for 6h window.

jordan: Good call. I drafted an alert runbook and linked it here: https://docs.internal/redwood/alerts/token-cost-drift. Will add to the PR as well.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for instrumentation v2: 2025-06-15T23:00Z → will route 5% traffic initially. No blocking flags.

praveen: After topic creation I'll flip the ingestion flag and coordinate backfill of a small sample to staging.

kai: I'll add a small synthetic ingestion script (500 events) in the PR so QA can validate latency buckets and cost attribution. PR update incoming in ~1h.

maria: :shipit: once tests pass and infra flips. tagging @ops for production publish checklist.

ana: ana: summary for async readers: owners — jordan (pipeline), kai (schema + samples), praveen (infra). Blocker — kafka topic creation (ETA EOD tomorrow). Action items: maria to finish review today, praveen create topic, kai push sample + test. Re-open thread if anything changes.

jordan: Adding one more note — we should include `model_version` eventually for per-model cost baselines, but not blocking this rollout.

maria: Agreed. Let's iterate after the canary results.

ana: thanks all — will track in the sprint board and move the PR to review column when comments addressed. :thumbsup:
